title: Balanced ternary digital root of n
notes: a(n) is the iteration of A065363 until the value lies in {-1,0,1}. Comments record abs(a(n))=n mod 2, with A134453 / A134454 splitting the odd attractors. Knuth TAOCP Vol. 2 is cited. This is the prior-art identity of the digit-sum dynamics benchmark.
